subject: Region gating and hosting requirements — post-call action items
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@euretail.com>, Haruto Sato <haruto.sato@apacpay.jp>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Region gating and hosting requirements — post-call action items

Hi Lena / Haruto —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared next-step list and can align on whether Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private (VPC/on-prem) is the right path for EuroRetail. I captured the items that will materially affect hosting choice: 

- Data residency requirement: EU-only for PII and transaction logs; some anonymized telemetry can cross borders.
- Cross-region routing: you need requests from APAC customers to stay within APAC region and not traverse EU endpoints.
- Regulatory note: EU auditors will want 90-day access logs retained in-region.
- Performance: target p95 < 250ms for checkout chat flows.
- Procurement: finance prefers a single annual contract; security needs SOC2 + evidence for key controls.

Proposed immediate next steps (can you confirm owners & dates?):
1) Lena: share your residency/cert evidence matrix (what data must remain in EU vs can be routed) — due Tue, Apr 6.
2) Monica (me) + Ben: prepare a short matrix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for these specific constraints and proposed costs — deliver Thu, Apr 8.
3) Vivek: initial ops checklist for Private/VPC (KMS, peering, audit logs export options) — due Wed, Apr 7.
4) Joint: 30-minute follow-up to review matrix and procurement timeline — propose Fri, Apr 9 09:00 CET.

Attachments: I attached our short EU-Residency-Checklist to make it easier to map requirements.

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll adjust.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: EU-Residency-Checklist.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]
From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@euretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Haruto Sato <haruto.sato@apacpay.jp>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:15:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Region gating and hosting requirements — post-call action items

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the clear recap — that mirrors what we discussed. A few clarifications inline: 

> - Data residency requirement: EU-only for PII and transaction logs; some anonymized telemetry can cross borders.

Correct: raw transaction logs and user PII must remain in EU. Aggregated metrics are fine to replicate to APAC.

> - Cross-region routing: you need requests from APAC customers to stay within APAC region and not traverse EU endpoints.

We need request-handling (inference path) for APAC users to be served from APAC endpoints for latency and compliance. If Hosted means requests are routed from APAC to EU, that is a blocker unless a regional-hosted option is available.

> > Proposed immediate next steps

I will share our residency matrix by EOD Mon, Apr 5 (we have a short questionnaire our legal team fills out).

One more item: procurement will want a recommended fallback if APAC capacity is temporarily unavailable (e.g., auto-failover to dedicated instance in APAC or configured fallback to nearest region with no PII mirror). Can you include fallback patterns in your matrix?

Appreciate the checklist attachment — it helps.

Cheers,
Lena
Lena Müller
Head of Platform & Data Governance, EuroRetail GmbH
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Region gating and hosting requirements — post-call action items

Quick internal note — forwarding my procurement checklist (stub) so we can fold costs into Monica's matrix.

- Procurement prefers one-year commit but will accept quarterly billing if we clearly show TCO for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private.
- They will ask for a service-level fallback clause: 99.5% uptime for Hosted; for Dedicated they want 99.9% SLA with credits.
- Finance will need an estimated token volume by region (ask EuroRetail for current monthly active users by region).

Attachment: Procurement-Timeline.xlsx (small, editable)

Ben

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two small updates before our follow-up: 

1) We will include a short fallback matrix covering: (a) Hosted regional endpoints (if available), (b) Dedicated APAC pool (reserved), (c) Private VPC with in-region inference + queued spillover to Dedicated in strict cases. For each pattern we will note where PII can/cannot be mirrored.
2) Ben has shared procurement constraints; we will add an appendix that maps typical SLA/credit language so procurement has a starting point.

Can you confirm the follow-up time Fri, Apr 9 09:00 CET works for you? Also please send the questionnaire when you have it (we'll mark items that change hosting choice).

Thanks — looking forward to locking the recommendation matrix.

Best,
Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
